descriptionHtml:
MSI MAG A850GL PCIE5

850W 80 PLUS Gold Fully Modular ATX 3.1 / PCIe 5.1 Power Supply

General Specifications

Form FactorATX
Total Wattage850W
Efficiency Certification80 PLUS Gold (Up to 90%) / Cybenetics Gold
Modular DesignFully Modular (Flat Black Cables)
Standards CompatibilityATX 3.1 Ready / PCIe 5.1 Compliant
TopologyLLC Full Bridge with DC-to-DC module design
Dimensions (W x D x H)150 x 140 x 86 mm (Compact Form)
Cooling Fan Size120 mm
Fan Bearing TypeFluid Dynamic Bearing (FDB)

Power Output Specifications

AC Input Range100-240 VAC, 12A, 47-63Hz (Active PFC)
DC Output Rail+3.3V+5V+12V-12V+5Vsb
Max Amperage20.0A20.0A70.5A0.3A2.5A
Combined Power110W846W3.6W12.5W
Total Continuous Power850W

Heavy-Duty Protection Mechanisms

  • OCP (Over Current Protection)
  • OVP (Over Voltage Protection)
  • OPP (Over Power Protection) — Supports up to 200% total power excursion (1700W for 100μs)
  • OTP (Over Temperature Protection)
  • SCP (Short Circuit Protection)
  • UVP (Under Voltage Protection)
